Xiaomi 18 Pro Max versi global nongol di Geekbench, RAM 12GB dikonfirmasi

Xiaomi has already confirmed that the 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max will be launched internationally, unlike their predecessors from last year. And so with the 18 Ultra rumored to have been canceled , the 18 Pro Max will essentially be the company's flagship smartphone going into 2027. Now, its global version has been spotted in the online results database of Geekbench AI. It has the model number 2611FPNFAG. It's powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, just like its Chinese sibling, and in the specific prototype that was tested, that was paired with 12GB of RAM. In China the device is also offered with 16GB of RAM, but it remains to be seen whether that will be the case for the global version as well. There's also the usual question, regarding the models bound for the EU, about battery capacity - the Chinese 18 Pro has a 7,000 mAh battery, while the 18 Pro Max sports an 8,500 mAh cell. We'll see whether those numbers will remain unchanged. Anyway, the duo is unsurprisingly expected to launch globally running Android 17 with Xiaomi’s HyperOS 4 on top. As a quick refresher, note that the Chinese Xiaomi 18 Pro Max comes with a 6.9-inch LTPO AMOLED screen with 1208x2624 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, and 4,000-nit peak brightness, a 2.9-inch LTPO AMOLED cover screen with 596x976 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, and 4,000-nit peak brightness, 256/512GB/1TB of storage, a 200MP main camera with OIS, a 200MP periscope telephoto with OIS and 3.2x optical zoom, a 50MP ultrawide, and a 50MP selfie camera. wouldn't work as people who unlock bootloaders still account for less than 1% of Xiaomi users.

Berita ini disusun dari laporan GSMArena.
